text.es: Si tú y yo dejamos la relación, porque no podía sacarme a Fina de la cabeza. Porque no era capaz de entregarme, como tú te mereces. Imagínate ahora que sé que no se fue por voluntad propia.
text.en: You and I ended our relationship because I couldn't get Fina out of my head. Because I wasn't able to give myself to you, the way you deserve. Imagine now, knowing that she didn't leave of her own free will.
